notes.title: New game update!
notes.content:
- fixed a bug with Tetra's invisibility
 
- Hound animation bug fixes
 
- Demigod's mobile respawn ability has become an active ability
 
- the use of the Fisher harpoon is simplified
 
- fixed interruption of animations when knocking mech off their feet
 
- fixed errors in calculating damage coefficients for Omega (Kato) and Laser (Dominion)
 
- scout walking speed reduced
 
- reduced running speed for all mechs
 
- changes to the network engine for better synchronization of hits from the laser and Wasp
 
- reduced cooldown of Air Strike ability
 
- collider collision errors fixed to fix situations when a mech could pass through rocks
 
- fixed error displaying fractional values ​​of the amount of ammunition
 
- fixed a bug with jamming the rotation of the body after falling from high altitude
 
- destructibility added to some objects in Alaska and the Jungle
 
- fixed bug when the statistics of the Titan was considered separately from the statistics for other robots
 
- fixed achievements
 
- fixed bug with weapon transparency after installing it in the hangar
 
- fixed synchronization of weapons used by other players at the moment of entering the battle
 
- fixed aiming with a gamepad for FI-17 and VT-02

notes.title: Обновление TechWars: Global Conflict от 18.01.2019
notes.content:
Улучшена графика и расширено игровое пространство в локации "Джунгли"
 Гладиатор теперь может ремонтировать турели и мобильные точки возрождения с помощью Wasp и Wasp 2.0
 Поправили использование способности "Время Возмездия" робота Райвен
 Исправлены ошибки верстки описания способностей роботов в разделе крафта
 Исправлена ошибка масштабирования позиции установки турели на границах локаций и в каньоне в джунглях
 Улучшена передача ощущения выстрела из АКТ-14
 Исправлена ошибка, связанная с несрабатыванием ЭМИ Вольфрам на игроках (не NPC)
 Отрегулирован урон Wasp и WASP 2.0
 Увеличено время отката умения "рукопашное комбо" Ронина
 Уменьшено время отката умения "установка турелей" Гладиатора
 Увеличено базовое значение брони корпуса Разрушителея
 Увеличена базовая броня корпуса и ног Последнего Императора
 Уменьшена броня корпуса и ног Демигода
 Ослаблен эффект модуля "Self-repair" у Державы
 Увеличен урон орудия "FF-29"
 Изменена механика стрельбы ракетами "Harpy", и уменьшен урон этих ракет
 Исправлена ошибка связанная с периодическим зависанием в воздухе мин Стилфилда

notes.title: New Update
Update 15.10.18
notes.content:
1. Reduced AFK time required for player to be droped back to hangar.
2. Selling your “FLATOUT” now grants correct amount of resources
3. New animations and icon effects for killing sprees added.
4. New killing spree sound notification.
5. Button click sounds added to all menus, including hangar.
6. You can now re-customize you bot in customization window without freezes.
7. Ling nickname display bug fixed.
8. A rare bug, making players unable to respawn fixed.
9. Enemy minimap marks are now displayed in correct color, when new players connect to active game session.
10. Closed game session option is added for private games and tournaments.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Here comes the new update, which brings us these changes:
1)	Defeat screen updated (this screen will be further updated in future)
2)	Minimap enemy display updated. You can now see all enemies, that are visible for your allies on your minimap. This will make TDM mode more interesting.
3)	All bots are now displayed as special class icons on minimap.
4)	Kill log was added to the game. You can now see who made a killing blow, and what weapon was used.
5)	New icons for double kill and killing spree were added (not voiced yet)
6)	Climbing animation for Titan class bots was improved.
7)	Water splashes animation for «Hound» fixed.
8)	Bugs related to jumping down fixed.
You can join Open Beta here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/523740/Techwars_Gl..
Don’t forget to claim you «pioneer» bundle here: https://bs-gp.com/tw/

notes.title: New big update!
notes.content:
We continue to develop our game. And as a result, we proudly invite you to try out a new big update!

The game uses the latest version of the Unity engine, and this gives us:


Improved graphics with modern post-processed rendering

Improved overall game performance

Improved network optimization. We’ve fixed most lags

Improved modern sound effect adjustments


In addition, we’ve added:


Energy restoration for mech running

Replay value of locations multiplied by over 4 times

Additional mech voiceover

Fixed a huge number of bugs


The game development isn’t stopping there, it’s continuing even more. We’re continuing work on the development of a new class Titan mechs, mech customization and new game modes. Keep an eye on our news, and see you in battle!

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
Friends! Today we have a long-awaited game update! And anyone who bought the game or who has the key now can try it.
Here is a list of what's new this time:
-Hangar with a choice of mechs
-Earning credits and buying new mechs
-Ability to play with friends in party mode
-Two new top-level Scouts with jampjets and a set of abilities
-Bots, pretty smart and dangerous, now there's always someone to shoot at
- Improved server performance and increased the number of simultaneously playing mechs (now always at least 6 vs 6)

notes.title: New game update!
notes.content:
- Updated combat interface
- Ammunition limitation
- Indication of the remainder of ammunition
- New Support Robots Wolfram and Gladiator
- Improved controllability of robots (auto-turns in the direction of the sight)
- Full rebound of the support robots (but perhaps not yet final)
- New options for arranging resp points and flags for capture (run at the beginning of the session, a specific location mode is set randomly)
- Changed the aiming system, now the target can be hit more accurately, including the legs, hands and even the head. This is necessary to introduce tanks, aircraft and a more detailed system of robot damage to the game. (At the moment it can be seen visually, but a detailed damage system has not yet been introduced).
- New Stormtrooper is Hound model of Corporation Kato (flamethrower plus abilities).
- Effects are rough. Some icons of abilities are also rough.
- Increased the speed of movement of all robots, the gameplay has become significantly faster and more dynamic.
- Fisher has a new ability Hook, works like a scorpion in Mortal Combat, a funny thing in general (the hook's voice has not been added yet)
- There was a full-scale tutorial (while with the rough layout of the text and design)
- Fixed a huge number of bugs (you can say almost everything)
- The mechanics of Hound's self-guided missile
- Improved Hound's ability "Liberation of the Flame" - emits fiery waves, burns robots and objects
- Introduced a new Hound's "Improved Sprint" ability, robot acceleration for 4 seconds
- A new Stormtrooper of Dominion corp named Razor was introduced
- Introduced a new mechanic Razor firing mortar
- There was a new ability of Razor "Specialization of Destruction" - an -
 increase in the radius of damage of any bursting projectiles (at the moment they are mine mortars)
